notes.title: Map Changes
notes.content:
Changed few things all over the map on normal mode, most importantly the "cliff" at the beginning and the spaceship at the end.

Fixed the bug where you fall through the floor near the breakable walls (at least I hope so)

Added a little glare to very small platforms at the end, so they're more visible

notes.title: Graphics Update Part 1
notes.content:
[h1]Graphics Revamp Part 1[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289458/14772137f782367749b0b6a1e02c045d5b6b65fa.png[/img]

The update is finally here, it took me way more time than I expected, but that doesn't matter.

Basically every texture in the forest environment got changed to a better looking version of it.
Most important one for sure is the new grass, that doesn't make your eyes bleed...

The second thing about this update is the new background in the game, that adds nice depth and feeling of actually moving in the world of Bounce Quest. With it added the game overall just looks better, a lot.

------------

Aside from that I also fixed many minor issues and bugs like:
- Cube not bouncing of wall after sliding on slopes facing left at angle larger than 20 degrees in Normal Mode
- ... if you understand what is the first one, then nice, there were just few similar things and I seriously don't want to come up with sentences to explain them.



I hope you like the changes, the game is now 2x easier when your eyes don't bleed from looking at it, sooo... Good luck!

notes.title: Christmas Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289458/7cce15f61dd15f170cdfe93682057f21d3f5dda7.png[/img]

[h1]Christmas Update ![/h1]

[h3]A whole new map got added![/h3]
In the Christmas Challenge map you need to move the present to the other side of the map in order to complete it. The difficulty is coming from different things that normally, so the map changes your focus 180 degrees.
The prize after completing the challenge is... a [b]Hat[/b]! Limited Santa hat, that changes the appearance of your cube!

For the next few weeks the menu will be changed to a Christmas styled one! With snow falling in the background, cube wearing a hat and a new AlphaLynx Track!
The menu as well as the challenge contain new Christmas themed music!

[h3]1.1 Update notes:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Added Christmas Challenge
[*] Added Hats
[*] Added 2 New songs
[*] Changed Range of aiming
[*] Changed Cursor to be more precise
[*] Increased The friction when on ground
[*] Made Normal mode slightly easier
[/olist]

Hope to see your opinion on the new update,
Make sure to check out AlphaLynx!

[b]THE GAME IS ON SALE TILL THE END OF THE YEAR[/b]
